tei:div.tei:p: "$ 0* !0* "0* #0* ༄༅// rgyal ba'i sras kyi lag len so bdun ma bzhugs so//

༄༅// na mo lo ke shwa ra ye/ gang gis chos kun 'gro 'ong med gzigs kyang*// 'gro ba'i don la gcig tu brtson mdzad pa// bla ma mchog dang spyan ras gzigs mgon la// rtag tu sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// phan bde'i 'byung gnas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams// dam chos bsgrubs las byung ste de yang ni// de yi lag len shes la rag las pas// rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len bshad par bya// 1 dal 'byor gru chen rnyed dka' thob dus 'dir// bdag gzhan 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral bya'i phyir// nyin dang mtshan du g.yel ba med par ni// nyan sems bsgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 2 gnyen gyi phyogs la 'dod chags chu ltar g.yo// dgra yi phyogs la zhe sdang me ltar 'bar// blang dor brjed pa'i gti mug mun nag can// pha yul spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 3 yul ngan spangs pas nyon mongs rim gyis 'grib// rnam g.yeng med pas dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel// rig pa dwangs pas chos la nges shes skye// dben pa bsten pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 4 yun ring 'grogs pa'i mdza' shes so sor 'bral// 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i nor rdzas bshul du lus// lus kyi mgron khang rnam shes mgron pos bor// tshe 'di blos btang rgyal sras lag len yin// 5 gang dang 'grogs na dug gsum 'phel 'gyur zhing*// thos bsam bsgom pa'i bya ba nyams 'gyur pa// byams dang snying rje med par sgyur byed pa'i// grogs ngan spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 6 gang zhig bsten na nyes pa zad 'gyur zhing*// yon tan yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel 'gyur ba'i// bshes gnyen dam pa rang gi lus bas kyang*// gces par 'dzin pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 7 rang yang 'khor ba'i btson rar bcing pa yi// 'jig rten lha yis su zhig skyob par nus// de phyir gang la skyabs na mi bslu ba'i// dkon mchog skyabs 'gro rgyal sras lag len yin//

8 shin tu bzod dka'i ngan song sdug bsngal rnams// sdig pa'i las kyi 'bras bur thub pas gsungs// de phyir srog la bab kyang sdig pa'i las// nam yang mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin// 9 srid gsum bde ba rtswa rtse'i zil pa bzhin// yud tsam zhig gis 'jig pa'i chos can yin// nam yang mi 'gyur thar pa'i go 'phang mchog / don du gnyer ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 10 thog med dus nas bdag la brtse ba can// ma rnams sdug na rang bdes ci zhig bya// de phyir mtha' yas sems can bsgral bya'i phyir// byang chub sems bskyed rgyal sras lag len yin// 11 sdug bsngal ma lus bdag bde 'dod las byung*// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzhan phan sems las 'khrungs// de phyir bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag / yang dag brje ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 12 su dag 'dod chen dbang gis bdag gi nor// thams cad 'phrog gam 'phrog tu 'jug na yang*// lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge ba rnams// de la bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 13 bdag la nyes pa cung zad med bzhin du// gang dag bdag gi mgo bo gcod byed na'ang*// snying rje'i dbang gis de yi sdig pa rnams// bdag la len pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 14 'ga' zhig bdag la mi snyan sna tshogs pa// stong gsum khyab par sgrogs par byed na yang*// byams pa'i sems kyis slar yang de nyid kyi// yon tan brjod pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 15 'gro mang 'dus pa'i dbus su 'ga' zhig gis// mtshang nas brus shing tshig ngan smra na yang*// de la dge ba'i bshes kyi 'du shes kyis// gus par 'dud pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 16 bdag gi bu bzhin gces par bskyangs pa'i mis// bdag la dgra bzhin blta bar byed na'ang*// nad kyis btab pa'i bu la ma bzhin du// lhag par brtse ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 17 rang dang mnyam pa'am dman pa'i skye bo yis//

nga rgyal dbang gis brnyas thabs byed na yang*// bla ma bzhin du gus pas bdag nyid kyi// spyi bor len pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 18 'tsho bas phongs shing rtag tu mi yis brnyas// tshabs chen nad dang gdon gyis btab kyang slar// 'gro kun sdig sdug bdag la len byed cing*// zhum pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 19 snyan par grags shing 'gro mang spyi bos btud// rnam thos bu yi nor 'dra thob gyur kyang*// srid pa'i dpal 'byor snying po med gzigs nas// khengs pa med pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 20 rang gi zhe sdang dgra bo ma thul na// phyi rol dgra bo btul zhing 'phel bar 'gyur// de phyir byams dang snying rje'i dmag dpung gis// rang rgyud 'dul ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 21 'dod pa'i yon tan lan tshwa'i chu dang 'dra// ji tsam spyad kyang sred pa 'phel bar 'gyur// gang la zhen chags skye ba'i dngos po rnams// 'phral la spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 22 ji ltar snang ba 'di dag rang gi sems// sems nyid gdod nas spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// de nyid shes nas gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rnams// yid la mi byed rgyal sras lag len yin// 23 yid du 'ong ba'i yul dang 'phrad pa na// dbyar gyi dus kyi 'ja' tshon ji bzhin du// mdzes par snang yang bden par mi lta zhing*// zhen chags spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin/ 24 sdug bsngal sna tshogs rmi lam bu shi ltar// 'khrul snang bden par bzung bas a thang chad// de phyir mi mthun rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe// 'khrul par lta ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 25 byang chub 'dod pas lus kyang gtong dgos na// phyi rol dngos po rnams la smos ci dgos// de phyir lan dang rnam smin mi re ba'i// sbyin pa gtong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 26 tshul khrims med par rang don mi 'grub na// gzhan don bsgrub par 'dod pa gad mo'i gnas//

de phyir srid pa'i 'dun pa med pa yis// tshul khrims bsrung ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 27 dge ba'i longs spyod 'dod pa'i rgyal sras la// gnod byed thams cad rin chen gter dang mtshungs// de phyir kun la zhe 'gras med pa yi// bzod pa sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 28 rang don 'ba' zhig bsgrub pa'i nyan rang yang*// mgo la me shor bzlog ltar brtson mthong na// 'gro kun don du yon tan 'byung gnas kyi// brtson 'grus rtsom pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 29 zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// nyon mongs rnam par 'joms par shes byas nas// gzugs med bzhi las yang dag 'das pa yi// bsam gtan sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 30 shes rab med na pha rol phyin lnga yis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par mi nus pas// thabs dang ldan zhing 'khor gsum mi rtog pa'i// shes rab sgom pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 31 rang gi 'khrul pa rang gis ma brtags na// chos pa'i gzugs kyis chos min byed srid pas// de phyir rgyun du rang gi 'khrul pa la// brtags nas spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 32 /nyon mongs dbang gis rgyal sras gzhan dag gis// nyes pa gleng na bdag nyid nyams 'gyur bas// theg pa che la zhugs pa'i gang zag gis// nyes pa mi smra rgyal sras lag len yin// 33 /rnyed bkur dbang gis phan tshun rtsod 'gyur zhing*// thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba nyams 'gyur bas// mdza' bshes khyim dang sbyin bdag khyim rnams la// chags pa spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 34 rtsub mo'i tshig gis gzhan sems 'khrug 'gyur zhing*// rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod tshul nyams 'gyur bas// de phyir gzhan gyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i// tshig rtsub spong ba rgyal sras lag len yin// 35 nyon mongs goms na gnyen pos bzlog dka' bas// dran shes skyes bus gnyen po'i mtshon bzung nas//

chags sogs nyon mongs dang po skyes ma thag / 'bur 'joms byed pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 36 mdor na gang du spyod lam ci byed kyang*// rang gi sems kyi gnas skabs ci 'dra zhes// rgyun du dran dang shes bzhin ldan pa yis// gzhan don sgrub pa rgyal sras lag len yin// 37 de ltar brtson pas bsgrub pa'i dge ba rnams// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal bsal bya'i phyir// 'khor gsum rnam par dag pa'i shes rab kyis// byang chub bsngo ba rgyal sras lag len yin// mdo rgyud bstan bcos rnams las gsungs pa'i don// dam pa rnams kyi gsung gi rjes 'brang nas// rgyal sras rnams kyi lag len sum cu bdun// rgyal sras lam la slob 'dod don du bkod// blo gros dman zhing sbyang pa chung ba'i phyir// mkhas pa dgyes pa'i sdeb sbyor ma mchis te// mdo dang dam pa'i gsung la brten pa'i phyir// rgyal sras lag len 'khrul med lags par sems// 'on kyang rgyal sras spyod pa rlabs chen rnams// blo dman bdag 'dra gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// 'gal dang ma 'brel la sogs nyes pa'i tshogs// dam pa rnams kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol// de las byung ba'i dge bas 'gro ba kun// don dam kun rdzob byang chub sems mchog gis// srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa'i// spyan ras gzigs mgon de dang mtshungs par shog// /ces pa 'di rang gzhan la phan pa'i don du lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i btsun pa thogs med kyis dngul chu'i rin chen phug tu sbyar ba'o/// /
